issues.description: Command and description are concatenated without spacing or delimiter. The text '$ mkdir ~/Hello-WorldCreates a directory...' runs together, making it difficult to distinguish where the command ends and the description begins.
issues.suggestion: Add proper formatting with either a newline, markdown code block, or clear delimiter between the command and its description. For example: '$ mkdir ~/Hello-World\nCreates a directory for your project called "Hello-World" in your user directory' or use a consistent format like '$ mkdir ~/Hello-World - Creates a directory...'

issues.suggestion: Add proper formatting with either a newline, markdown code block, or clear delimiter. For example: '$ cd ~/Hello-World\nChanges the current working directory to your newly created directory' or use consistent delimiter syntax.
